candidates.title: Defer Sign-In After Pet Creation
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet selection and photo upload so users create their companion before committing to an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently has early dropoff (72.9% conversion); building emotional connection with the pet first boosts sign-in motivation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet creation is explicitly allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Deferring sign-in removes friction early, though requires flow restructuring.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Preview Grid
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split stage layout with animated previews and rich choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and high decision time (median 89s), showing users struggle with choice visual clarity.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Guide Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated controls guide screen before completion explaining how to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, talk to, or hide the pet.

new_controls_guide.headline: How to Control Your Desktop Pet
new_controls_guide.body: Click your pet to interact, drag to position anywhere on your screen, and right-click for options.

guard.reason: Adding a controls guide screen within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adds new screen addressing widespread post-onboarding support complaints.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Preset Fallback
candidates.change: Introduce visual preset selection cards on the photo upload screen as a reliable fallback if custom photo processing fails.
candidates.why: Support tickets highlighted custom pet creation failures and rendering issues during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: If custom photo upload stalls, select a styled preset companion to continue instantly.

guard.reason: Adding preset fallback choice cards to the photo upload screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Fixes failure dropoffs in adoption step, which has the highest churn.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Progress & Tips
candidates.change: Add an explicit progress bar, estimated time remaining, and tip carousel to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting home step has a high median duration of 201s (mean 2336s) and complaints about the pet not displaying.

guard.reason: Adding progress indicators and tips during a real wait is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait times at home step with wait status and tips.

candidates.title: Cloud Save Protected Sign-In Callout
candidates.change: Display explicit cloud backup trust badges on the sign-in screen highlighting protection against pet progress loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to Cloud
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your custom pet safe and sync progress across all updates.

guard.reason: Adding trust badges to the sign-in screen is allowed and complies with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy/badge change directly targeting progress loss complaints.

candidates.title: Streamlined Value Proposition Story Copy
candidates.change: Update initial story headline and body text to immediately explain what a desktop pet companion does.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a long mean time (514s), indicating user hesitation at the very start of onboarding.

story.headline: Adopt Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring an adorable animated pet to life on your desktop to keep you company and enhance your workflow.

guard.reason: Updated story copy continues to fulfill the job of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Quick copy tweak targeting high initial hesitation time.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Reframe the adoption certificate screen into a checklist layout summarizing name, personality traits, and desktop permissions.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is lowest at 60.9%; structuring the certificate as a clear checklist builds confidence before completion.

guard.reason: Reframe to a checklist layout loses the official stamp required for the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop system notifications and explicit status text so users know when their pet has loaded on the screen.
candidates.why: Mean wait time of 2336s indicates users switch away while waiting and lose track of app launch.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to appear!

guard.reason: Adding system notifications and timing info to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: System notification brings back users lost during long background asset loads.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Shortcut Visual Hint
candidates.change: Add a visual hotkey badge and interactive hint on the home intro screen showing how to summon the pet.
candidates.why: Support emails show confusion about pet visibility on desktop and lost control post-onboarding.

home_intro.hint: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet to the front of your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding hotkey visual hints to the home intro overlay is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Visual hotkey hint addresses finish step dropoff and support complaints.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
